title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第三十七章、天大的错误

    冷宫大火和狸猫换太子的案子都已经真相大白了。楚珠绑架八王爷是为了让包拯来查案，但包拯还是有不明白的地方。
    他问楚珠：“事情已经过去二十一年了，为什么决定现在查案呢？”
    楚珠深吸一口气说道：“以前，我觉得娘娘和孩子都死了，说什么都没有意义了。我只想安静地在无人岛守着娘娘的坟墓过完一生，但是今年中秋节皇上出宫与民同乐时，我在街上看到了皇上，突然发现我可能犯了一个天大的错误。我急切地想要知道答案，而唯一知道答案的人只有八王爷。于是我每天都去八王爷府外面看一看，但他一直没有回家。直到前几天，他终于回来了。我马上画了一幅画，让一个眼睛不好的孩子帮我送进王府给八王爷。当时我想，如果八王爷不认识画，那就是我错了。如果八王爷认识画，他一定会来南湖见我，那我想的就是对的。”
    包拯点头道：“你画的是一个食盒。”
    “是的，是当年装着娘娘的孩子出宫时用的那个食盒。当我在街上看到皇上以后，我开始回忆那一晚马超抱着孩子跳江时的样子。当时我站得很远，其实并没有看清楚，马超抱的到底是孩子，还是只是包着孩子的小被子。我想张怀应该也没有看清，他和我一样都只是远远地看到马超那样紧紧地抱着，就觉得他抱的一定是孩子。”
    张怀惊恐地瞪大了双眼，挂着泪的脸不知所措地向太后望去。太后也是一脸震惊，下意识握紧了手心。
    “所以，你怀疑马超用包孩子的被子骗过了张怀，而真正的孩子还活着？”
    “是的，我怀疑孩子还活着，也许是马超为了骗张怀，把孩子和食盒藏在了什么地方。张怀不知道我们用食盒装过孩子，所以没有怀疑，看到马超抱着孩子跳江后就回去了。而我当时太粗心了，也没有发现问题，事后也没有去找孩子。因此，我想确认那天晚上八王爷是不是见过那个食盒和里面的孩子，是不是他把孩子带走了，所以画了食盒的画给八王爷。”
    所有人的目光都望向了八王爷，八王爷面色沉重，他没有说话，或者他在想要怎么开口。
    “我想八王爷看到了那个食盒，也看到了那个孩子。正是因为遇到了八王爷，那个孩子才活了下来。”包拯看着八王爷说。
    八王爷的表情轻松了一些，他朝一脸关切的皇帝点点头，然后慢慢说起了二十一年前的那个晚上发生的事。
fullText.traditional:
第三十七章、天大的錯誤

    冷宮大火和狸貓換太子的案子都已經真相大白了。楚珠綁架八王爺是為了讓包拯來查案，但包拯還是有不明白的地方。
    他問楚珠：“事情已經過去二十一年了，為什麼決定現在查案呢？”
    楚珠深吸一口氣說道：“以前，我覺得娘娘和孩子都死了，說什麼都沒有意義了。我只想安靜地在無人島守著娘娘的墳墓過完一生，但是今年中秋節皇上出宮與民同樂時，我在街上看到了皇上，突然發現我可能犯了一個天大的錯誤。我急切地想要知道答案，而唯一知道答案的人只有八王爺。於是我每天都去八王爺府外面看一看，但他一直沒有回家。直到前幾天，他終於回來了。我馬上畫了一幅畫，讓一個眼睛不好的孩子幫我送進王府給八王爺。當時我想，如果八王爺不認識畫，那就是我錯了。如果八王爺認識畫，他一定會來南湖見我，那我想的就是對的。”
    包拯點頭道：“你畫的是一個食盒。”
    “是的，是當年裝著娘娘的孩子出宮時用的那個食盒。當我在街上看到皇上以後，我開始回憶那一晚馬超抱著孩子跳江時的樣子。當時我站得很遠，其實並沒有看清楚，馬超抱的到底是孩子，還是只是包著孩子的小被子。我想張懷應該也沒有看清，他和我一樣都只是遠遠地看到馬超那樣緊緊地抱著，就覺得他抱的一定是孩子。”
    張懷驚恐地瞪大了雙眼，掛著淚的臉不知所措地向太后望去。太后也是一臉震驚，下意識握緊了手心。
    “所以，你懷疑馬超用包孩子的被子騙過了張懷，而真正的孩子還活著？”
    “是的，我懷疑孩子還活著，也許是馬超為了騙張懷，把孩子和食盒藏在了什麼地方。張懷不知道我們用食盒裝過孩子，所以沒有懷疑，看到馬超抱著孩子跳江後就回去了。而我當時太粗心了，也沒有發現問題，事後也沒有去找孩子。因此，我想確認那天晚上八王爺是不是見過那個食盒和裡面的孩子，是不是他把孩子帶走了，所以畫了食盒的畫給八王爺。”
    所有人的目光都望向了八王爺，八王爺面色沉重，他沒有說話，或者他在想要怎麼開口。
    “我想八王爺看到了那個食盒，也看到了那個孩子。正是因為遇到了八王爺，那個孩子才活了下來。”包拯看著八王爺說。
    八王爺的表情輕鬆了一些，他朝一臉關切的皇帝點點頭，然後慢慢說起了二十一年前的那個晚上發生的事。

sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǒu rén de mù guāng dōu wàng xiàng le bā wáng ye bā wáng ye miàn sè chén zhòng
sentences.english: Everyone’s gaze turned toward the Eighth Prince. The Eighth Prince’s expression was grave.

sentences.simplified: 他没有说话，或者他在想要怎么开口。
sentences.traditional: 他沒有說話，或者他在想要怎麼開口。
sentences.pinyin: tā méi yǒu shuō huà huò zhě tā zài xiǎng yào zěn me kāi kǒu
sentences.english: He didn’t speak, or perhaps he was thinking about how to begin.

sentences.simplified: “我想八王爷看到了那个食盒，也看到了那个孩子。
sentences.traditional: “我想八王爺看到了那個食盒，也看到了那個孩子。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bā wáng ye kàn dào le nà ge shí hé yě kàn dào le nà ge hái zi
sentences.english: “I think the Eighth Prince saw the food box and also saw the child.

sentences.simplified: 正是因为遇到了八王爷，那个孩子才活了下来。”包拯看着八王爷说。
sentences.traditional: 正是因為遇到了八王爺，那個孩子才活了下來。”包拯看著八王爺說。
sentences.pinyin: zhèng shì yīn wèi yù dào le bā wáng ye nà ge hái zi cái huó le xià lai bāo zhěng kàn zhe bā wáng ye shuō
sentences.english: It was precisely because of the encounter with the Eighth Prince that the child survived,” Bao Zheng said, looking at the Eighth Prince.

sentences.simplified: 八王爷的表情轻松了一些，
sentences.traditional: 八王爺的表情輕鬆了一些，
sentences.pinyin: bā wáng ye de biǎo qíng qīng sōng le yì xiē
sentences.english: The Eighth Prince’s expression relaxed a little.

sentences.simplified: 他朝一脸关切的皇帝点点头，然后慢慢说起了二十一年前的那个晚上发生的事。
sentences.traditional: 他朝一臉關切的皇帝點點頭，然後慢慢說起了二十一年前的那個晚上發生的事。
sentences.pinyin: tā cháo yì liǎn guān qiè de huáng dì diǎn diǎn tóu rán hòu màn man shuō qǐ le èr shí yī nián qián de nà ge wǎn shang fā shēng de shì
sentences.english: He nodded toward the concerned-looking emperor and then slowly began to recount the events of that night twenty-one years ago.

sentence_translations: Chapter 37: A Huge Mistake
The truth about the fire in the Cold Palace and the case of exchanging a leopard cat for a prince had already been revealed.
Chu Zhu kidnapped the Eighth Prince in order to get Bao Zheng to investigate the case.
However, there were still things that Bao Zheng did not understand.
He asked Chu Zhu, “It’s been twenty-one years since the incident. Why did you decide to investigate now?”
Chu Zhu took a deep breath and said, ..
.. “Before, I thought that the noble consort and the child were both dead, so nothing I said would have mattered.
I just wanted to live the rest of my life quietly on the uninhabited island, guarding the noble consort’s grave.
However, during this year’s Mid-Autumn Festival, when the emperor left the palace to celebrate with the people, ..
.. I saw him in town and suddenly realized that I might have made a huge mistake.
I wanted to know the answer urgently, and the only person who knew the answer was the Eighth Prince.
So I went to the Eighth Prince’s mansion every day to look, but he never came home. He finally came home a few days ago.
I immediately made a drawing and had a child with poor eyesight deliver it to the prince’s mansion for the Eighth Prince.
At that time, I thought, if the Eighth Prince didn’t recognize the drawing, then I would have been mistaken.
If the Eighth Prince recognized the drawing, ..
.. he would definitely come to the South Lake to see me, and what I had been thinking would be correct.”
Bao Zheng nodded and said, “You drew a food box.”
“Yes, it’s the food box that was used to carry the noble consort’s child out of the palace back then.
When I saw the emperor in town, I began to recall the scene of Ma Chao holding the child and jumping into the river that night.
At that time, I was standing quite far away.
I didn’t actually see clearly whether Ma Chao was holding a child or just the small quilt that was wrapped around the child.
I think Zhang Huai probably didn’t see clearly either.
Like me, he only saw from a distance that Ma Chao was holding something tightly and just assumed that he must be holding the child.”
Zhang Huai’s eyes widened with fear, and his tear-streaked face looked helplessly toward the empress dowager.
The empress dowager also had shock written all over her face, and she subconsciously clenched her fist.
“So, you suspect that Ma Chao deceived Zhang Huai with a quilt that was wrapped around the child, and the real child is still alive?”
“Yes, I suspect that the child is still alive.
Perhaps Ma Chao hid the child and the food box somewhere in order to deceive Zhang Huai.
Zhang Huai didn’t know that we had put the child in the food box, so he didn’t suspect anything.
After seeing Ma Chao jump into the river holding the child, he went back.
But I was too careless at the time. I didn’t notice anything unusual, and I didn’t go look for the child afterward.
Because of this, I want to confirm whether the Eighth Prince saw the food box and the child inside that night, ..
.. and whether he was the one who took the child away.
That’s why I drew the picture of the food box for the Eighth Prince.”
Everyone’s gaze turned toward the Eighth Prince. The Eighth Prince’s expression was grave.
He didn’t speak, or perhaps he was thinking about how to begin.
“I think the Eighth Prince saw the food box and also saw the child.
It was precisely because of the encounter with the Eighth Prince that the child survived,” Bao Zheng said, looking at the Eighth Prince.
The Eighth Prince’s expression relaxed a little.
He nodded toward the concerned-looking emperor and then slowly began to recount the events of that night twenty-one years ago.
